Subject: Delegated-signer notarization plan + TIN attestation for Helix Biotech

Hi Sana,

Thanks again for moving quickly on onboarding. We reviewed the W-8BEN-E you uploaded. Two points before we can clear PO creation:

1) TIN attestation: for foreign entities we require either the foreign TIN on the W-8BEN-E OR a short attestation letter from authorized signatory confirming the entity tax ID used for Redwood payments. The PDF you sent has the entity name and address but the TIN field is blank.

2) Notarization / delegated signer: your finance lead indicated the CFO is traveling and wants to delegate signing authority to a local AP manager. We accept a notarized delegation letter naming the delegate, plus the signed W-8BEN-E by the delegate. If the delegation is executed outside the U.K., we need an apostille or an embassy/legalisation stamp.

Could you: 1) re-upload a W-8BEN-E with the foreign TIN or attach a signed attestation (short paragraph on letterhead), and 2) provide a notarized delegation letter (PDF) or tell us if you need to use an alternate path (DocuSign with certified e-notary / embassy apostille)?

If helpful, I attached a short delegation template and a checklist for the PO gate. We can expedite once we receive the notarized docs.

Thanks — aiming to have the PO issued this week if docs are in place.

Best,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding (Procurement)
Redwood Inference
attachments: Delegation_Authority_template.docx, W-8BEN-E_initial_fill.pdf

Sana — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching drafts. Two quick clarifications from procurement/legal: 

• Notarization path: Redwood accepts either (A) a fully notarized delegation letter + apostille, or (B) a notarized delegation letter plus a certified electronic notary record (DocuSign with e-notary certificate) when apostille is impractical. If you can get the notarized letter in 1–2 business days but apostille will take longer, option (B) is acceptable as an interim deliverable so we can kick the PO. We will require the apostille within 10 business days after PO if option (B) is used.

• TIN attestation: the W-8BEN-E you attached has the foreign TIN handwritten in Box 6 by Tom — thanks. We just need a one-line attestation on company letterhead confirming that the TIN shown is the entity's official tax identifier for payments to Redwood (signed by the CFO or authorized delegate).

I can send an e-sign DocuSign package for the delegation letter + attestation to speed the notarization/e-notary flow. Would you prefer DocuSign or will you handle local notary + apostille? If DocuSign, please confirm the signers and email addresses.

Jordan — looping you for FYI on PO timing.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Monica — final confirmation. We used a local notary this morning and then submitted for apostille; the notary provided a certified notarial page (scanned). Tom signed the W-8BEN-E in presence of notary. Attached are: the scanned notarized delegation letter (signed and stamped), the scanned W-8BEN-E (signed by Tom), and the apostille receipt. The apostille certificate should be available in 48–72 hours; we will upload once received.

Per your request, I included a one-line attestation on company letterhead signed by CFO: "Helix Biotech confirms that the tax identifier entered in Box 6 of the attached W-8BEN-E is the company's official tax identification number for cross-border payments to Redwood Inference."

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_signed_with_notary.pdf, Delegation_Notarized_scanned.pdf, Apostille_receipt.pdf

Once you confirm these satisfy the PO gate we will expect the PO number and initial invoice instructions.

Best regards,
